questions.question: King David had gold and silver ready for the temple. What question did he then ask the gathered people?

answers.text: Who is willing to consecrate himself to the LORD today
Who will march out against the Philistines with me
Who will go up to Lebanon to cut cedar

questions.question: In his prayer, King David asked who he and his people were to give so generously. What answer did he give God?

answers.text: Everything comes from God's own hand
The people worked extra hard all year
The king of Tyre sent them help

questions.question: After sacrifices and feasting before the LORD, what did the people do for David's son Solomon for a second time?
After forty years as king of Israel, how did David's life end?

answers.text: He died at a ripe old age full of honor
He fell in battle against the Philistines
He died alone and forgotten in the palace
